query:
SELECT id, requestNumber, status, urgencyLevel, updatedAt
FROM purchaseRequests
WHERE urgencyLevel IN ('urgente','emergencial')
  AND status NOT IN ('concluida','cancelada','rejeitada')
ORDER BY updatedAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
